name: Kong Ruili
source:
"I fear that you will forget everything - this peach garden, that I await your return - and vanish to some place where I cannot reach you."

Kong Ruili, the most precious person in the world to [url=/c7177]Taoluo[/url]. She lived a sheltered life in the Kong family estate in the Kunlun Mountains, spending her days playing the guzheng in the peach garden; always worrying and awaiting Taoluo's return from his Society assignments. Ruili was highly educated and a skilled guzheng player - an art she pursued alongside Taoluo's calling for Daitian swordplay. They would often hone their crafts together in the garden.

She was married to [url=/c7183]Liu Haojun[/url], her and Taoluo's childhood friend. Brutally gang raped, tortured and ultimately the subject of an experimental soul transfer, leading to her brain death; what could possibly have lead to Haojun's actions remain unknown.
